# SpaceControl

> Free, open-source macOS menu-bar app extending Mission Control with keyboard navigation, window controls, and Spaces shortcuts.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://retsubhtym.github.io/SpaceControl/)
- [Documentation index](https://retsubhtym.github.io/SpaceControl/#guides)
- [How to Navigate macOS Mission Control with Keyboard Shortcuts](https://retsubhtym.github.io/SpaceControl/guides/keyboard-navigation.html)
- [How to Manage and Close Windows in macOS Mission Control](https://retsubhtym.github.io/SpaceControl/guides/window-management.html)
- [How to Manage macOS Spaces and Move Windows Between Desktops](https://retsubhtym.github.io/SpaceControl/guides/spaces.html)
- [SpaceControl Architecture - Extending macOS Mission Control](https://retsubhtym.github.io/SpaceControl/guides/architecture.html)
